idea-plugin.name: Task Worktree
idea-plugin.description:
Create git worktrees from IntelliJ tasks, or define custom ones — branch a folder next to your repo and open it as a new IntelliJ project in a single step.

Features

  • Pick from open tasks across any configured task server (TargetProcess, Jira, YouTrack, GitHub, …) and spawn a worktree for the matching branch, or create a custom worktree on any new or existing local branch.
  • Searchable, two-section picker (existing worktrees + tasks) with type-to-filter for both the item list and the branch selector.
  • Create a new branch from any chosen base ref (local or remote) — branch a worktree off e.g. main without switching to the main worktree first. Picking a remote branch creates a local tracking branch.
  • Open or remove existing worktrees inline. The main repo worktree is protected from deletion.
  • Optionally copies the source repo's .idea/ into each new worktree so the IDE opens with project settings intact.
  • Copy additional un-tracked files (e.g. .env, config/**) from the main repo working tree into every new worktree using configurable glob patterns — directories are copied recursively.
  • Automatically drops the removed worktree's path from Recent Projects; one-click bulk cleanup of stranded greyed-out entries.

Settings under Settings | Tools | Task Worktree (applied globally across projects): base worktrees directory, the .idea/ copy toggle, additional files-to-copy glob patterns, configurable branch and worktree folder name patterns (variables: id, number, type, summary, project), and a task type remapping table.

Default shortcut: Alt+Shift+P.

action.description: Pick a task and create a git worktree for it
